documents.title: Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of The Board Meeting Held On October 30, 2026
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of EGM
Board Meeting Intimation for Meeting To Be Held On October 30, 2026
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Vadilal Industries reported that its international business grew by 54% in FY19, crossing the $20 million milestone and now accounting for over 25% of total revenues. Management noted that domestic performance was impacted by an extended winter in Q4 FY19 but has since seen a recovery with double-digit growth in the FY20 summer season. The company plans to invest approximately Rs. 30-35 crore in capital expenditure during FY20 and intends to implement price increases in the second half of the year to counter rising milk costs. Vadilal Industries reported a 27% revenue growth in Q3 FY19, driven by a 71% surge in international business and 12% domestic growth.

guidance.claim: Management expects to deliver double digit growth driven by higher contribution from the international business.
guidance.quote: We also expect to deliver double digit growth with higher contribution from international business leading to margin expansion.

guidance.claim: The company expects to spend between Rs. 30-35 crore on regular capital expenditure during the year.
guidance.quote: We continue to incur regular capital expenditure and expect to spend Rs. 30-35 crore during the year.

guidance.claim: Management estimated capital expenditure for FY 20 at approximately Rs. 30 crore.
guidance.quote: Estimated capex for FY 20 at ~ Rs. 30 crore

guidance.claim: The company expects another year of growth in FY20 by leveraging its brand.
guidance.quote: Going forward, we see another good year in FY20 as we leverage the Vadilal brand for ongoing growth.

guidance.claim: Management maintains a positive business outlook driven by consumption and international traction.
guidance.quote: Going forward, we maintain our positive business outlook – better environment for consumption, demand shift to the organized sector and continued traction in international business.

guidance.claim: Subdued raw material prices are expected to benefit future margins.
guidance.quote: We have been engaging with raw material suppliers for the next season and prices continue to be subdued, which should benefit margins.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic business experienced weakness in Q4 due to severe weather conditions that extended the winter until the end of March.
demand_outlook.quote: Domestic business saw weakness in Q4 due to exceptionally severe weather conditions that extended the winter till the end of March this year and impacted the consumption of ice cream in many of our core markets.

demand_outlook.claim: International business now accounts for over 25% of revenues, driven by demand from the Indian diaspora in the U.S. and other regions.
demand_outlook.quote: International business is now over 25% of revenues and growth is driven by strong demand for our high quality ice creams and other products within the sizeable Indian diaspora community in the U.S. and some other geographies.

demand_outlook.claim: The company started FY20 with double digit growth in the summer season and 25% revenue expansion in the international business.
demand_outlook.quote: We have started FY20 with double digit growth in the summer season and 25% revenue expansion in international business.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic business growth is reverting to historical trends after being temporarily impacted by changes in the operating environment.
demand_outlook.quote: Domestic business growth, temporarily impacted by recent changes in operating environment and consumption spending, is now reverting to historical trends

demand_outlook.claim: Strong volume growth in US ice cream sales is being driven by latent demand for quality Indian products.
demand_outlook.quote: Latent demand for quality Indian products driving strong volume growth in US ice cream sales

demand_outlook.claim: Management is looking to penetrate deeper into international markets to address gaps in product availability.
demand_outlook.quote: Based on the strong growth in demand, we are looking to penetrate deeper into these markets to address the gap in the availability of Indian products to the community.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic growth is being driven by consumer brand preference and distribution expansion.
demand_outlook.quote: Growth in domestic business was driven by consumer preference for the Vadilal brand and continued expansion in distribution/POS presence.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has committed distribution investments in multiple U.S. locations to access the Indian diaspora.
capex_expansion.quote: We have already committed distribution investments in multiple locations in the U.S. that allow us widespread access to the sizeable Indian diaspora in key target markets.

capex_expansion.claim: No major capital expenditure is anticipated for capacity enhancement.
capex_expansion.quote: No major capital expenditure anticipated on capacity enhancement

capex_expansion.claim: The estimated capital expenditure for FY19 is approximately Rs. 35 crore.
capex_expansion.quote: Estimated capex for FY 19 at ~ Rs. 35 crore

capex_expansion.claim: Management is investing in IT enhancements and balancing equipment at factories.
capex_expansion.quote: We are also making investments in IT enhancement and balancing equipment at the factory to drive greater volumes.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin expanded by over 600 basis points last year due to volume growth, benign raw material prices, and higher realizations from international operations.
margins_costs.quote: Gross margin expanded by over 600 basis points last year on the back of volume growth, benign raw material prices and larger contribution from international operations, where realizations are significantly higher.

margins_costs.claim: The cost of people resources increased significantly last year, largely due to U.S. operations which now employ over 50 people.
margins_costs.quote: Cost of people resources increased significantly last year, with a large contribution from U.S. operations that now have a base of over 50 employees.

margins_costs.claim: The company has visibility of stable costs covered until Q2 based on its raw material purchase and inventory position.
margins_costs.quote: Based on our raw material purchase and inventory position, we have visibility of stable costs covered till Q2.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin increased to 50% in Q3 FY19 from 40% in the previous year's corresponding quarter.
margins_costs.quote: gross margin increased to 50% in Q3 compared to 40% in the same quarter last year.

margins_costs.claim: The company has secured supply arrangements for the upcoming summer, providing visibility on input costs.
margins_costs.quote: Having already closed key supply arrangements for the upcoming summer season, we have clear visibility of input costs and expect strong contribution from sales.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin increased by over 600 basis points and EBITDA margin by approximately 1,000 basis points in Q2.
margins_costs.quote: Margins have improved significantly during the quarter – gross margin increased by over 600 bps to 44.4% and EBITDA margin by over ~1,000 bps.

margins_costs.claim: Margin expansion was achieved through volume growth, lower raw material prices, and cost discipline.
margins_costs.quote: This is in line with the recent trend of expansion and has been achieved through volume growth by utilizing existing capacities, lower raw material procurement prices and operating cost discipline.

margins_costs.claim: Higher realizations from international ice cream sales are contributing to improved profits.
margins_costs.quote: International ice cream sales come with higher realizations and contribution margins, which is also helping improve profits while increasing utilization of current capacities.

orders_capacity.claim: Production capacity expanded from 270,000 liters per day to 380,000 liters per day over the past few years.
orders_capacity.quote: Capacity expanded from 270,000 liters per day to 380,000 liters per day over the past few years

orders_capacity.claim: The company currently has a presence in 55,000 retail outlets across 26 Indian states.
orders_capacity.quote: Currently, we are present in 55,000 retail outlets in 26 states across the country.

orders_capacity.claim: The Bareilly facility has an ice cream production capacity of 150,000 liters per day.
orders_capacity.quote: Bareilly, Uttar Pradesh 150,000 liters per day Ice cream

orders_capacity.claim: Ice cream volumes expanded by 6.9% during the second quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: During Q2, we have continued our strong business momentum to expand ice cream volumes by 6.9%, driven by 6% domestic volume growth and 37% expansion in the international business.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's products currently reach 55,000 retail outlets across 26 states.
orders_capacity.quote: Currently, Vadilal products reach 55,000 retail outlets in 26 states and we remain committed to expand the network judiciously.

orders_capacity.claim: The Pundhra facility in Gujarat has a capacity of 230,000 liters per day.
orders_capacity.quote: Pundhra, Gujarat 230,000 liters per day Ice cream ISO-22000:2005 and BRC : Issue 6

capital_allocation.claim: The company reconstituted its outstanding debt to increase long tenure loans and reduce the cost of debt.
capital_allocation.quote: Reconstituted outstanding debt to increase long tenure loans and reduced cost of debt

capital_allocation.claim: Management intends to leverage operational surplus to rationalize debt and improve working capital management.
capital_allocation.quote: Leveraging surplus generated by operations to rationalize/ restructure debt and improve working capital management

capital_allocation.claim: Cash accretion and working capital improvements are allowing for planned debt rationalization.
capital_allocation.quote: However, cash accretion from the business and improvements in working capital allow us to continue debt rationalization as per plan and interest expenses have been decreasing accordingly.

risks_headwinds.claim: Severe weather conditions that extended the winter until the end of March impacted ice cream consumption in core markets.
risks_headwinds.quote: Domestic business saw weakness in Q4 due to exceptionally severe weather conditions that extended the winter till the end of March this year and impacted the consumption of ice cream in many of our core markets.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company expects to increase prices in the second half of the year as milk prices are currently at higher levels.
risks_headwinds.quote: As milk prices are at higher levels now, we will look to increasing prices in the second half of the year.

risks_headwinds.claim: The cost of people resources increased significantly, particularly from U.S. operations which now have over 50 employees.
risks_headwinds.quote: Cost of people resources increased significantly last year, with a large contribution from U.S. operations that now have a base of over 50 employees.

risks_headwinds.claim: Domestic growth was temporarily hindered by changes in the operating environment and consumer spending.
risks_headwinds.quote: Domestic business growth, temporarily impacted by recent changes in operating environment and consumption spending, is now reverting to historical trends

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to deliver double digit growth driven by higher contribution from the international business.
management_commitments.quote: We also expect to deliver double digit growth with higher contribution from international business leading to margin expansion.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to spend between Rs. 30-35 crore on regular capital expenditure during the year.
management_commitments.quote: We continue to incur regular capital expenditure and expect to spend Rs. 30-35 crore during the year.

management_commitments.claim: Management estimated capital expenditure for FY 20 at approximately Rs. 30 crore.
management_commitments.quote: Estimated capex for FY 20 at ~ Rs. 30 crore

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to increase prices in the second half of the year to offset higher milk prices.
management_commitments.quote: As milk prices are at higher levels now, we will look to increasing prices in the second half of the year.

management_commitments.quote: Estimated capex for FY 19 at ~ Rs. 35 crore
